key_insight: PATS turns training-time skills into a policy-aware scaffold that adapts guidance as the agent improves, instead of treating skills as fixed reusable artifacts.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical RLVR training strategy for long-horizon LLM agents that can improve task success while reducing prompt-token cost during training.
method: Convert rollout groups from the latest policy into evidence cards.
Use task-specific evaluation to revise, add, or remove context for later rollouts.
Train with environmental rewards under standard RLVR; discard the scaffold at deployment.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports gains of up to 18.6% on ALFWorld and WebShop, and competitive results on seven search-augmented QA benchmarks with 32.1% fewer prompt tokens than the baseline.
watch_item: Because the scaffold is dynamically adjusted from recent rollouts, performance may depend on reliable task-specific evaluation and careful control of when guidance is removed.
paper_title: PATS: Policy-Aware Training Scaffolding for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
